notes.decision: ⲛⲉⲉϩ rendered 'set over' — uses the verb ⲛⲉⲉϥ 'bear up, be set upon' (in accumulated vocabulary) with ⲁ- directional 'upon,' yielding 'the one who is set over.' Fits the hierarchy of the chief judge above all judges.
Rendered 'kingdom that does not fail'. ⲱϩ here likely = ⲱⲝⲛⲉ 'cease/fail' (in accumulated vocab) with negation ⲉⲛ. The eternal-kingdom motif fits the soteriological closure.

Rendered 'her purpose of heart' on the model of ⲡⲱⲕ ⲛⲍⲏⲧ (in accumulated vocab). ⲥⲱⲕ here functions as variant/scribal form of ⲡⲱⲕ — 'drawing-of-heart' = inward intent. Could alternatively be 'her drawing-forth of heart' (judgment-as-conclusion drawn from heart).

The doubled ⲡⲡ likely reflects ⲁ-ⲡ-ⲡⲙⲁ 'to this place' with demonstrative reduplication, or a scribal/transcription variant of ⲁⲡⲙⲁ 'to the place.' Translated 'to this place' to preserve the doubled form.

Translated 'to set a gushing of water'. ⲭⲉ likely = ⲕⲏ/ⲕⲱ 'to set, place' (infinitive), with ⲛ-ⲟⲩ-ⲃⲉⲃⲉ ⲙⲟⲩ as object 'a gushing of water'. The line begins mid-sentence (continuation from p.79). The sense fits the cosmic-establishment context: the 4th judge sets springs and prisons in the firmament.
ⲇⲣⲟ = Lyc. reflex of ϫⲣⲟ 'prevail, conquer'; with ⲁⲣⲁϩ '(over) him' = 'they prevailed over him'. The ⲇⲣⲁⲓⲧ qualitative 'victorious' (lines 15, 24) confirms the root.
The symbol ⳨ in transcription represents ϯ 'give'; thus ⲡⲉⲧ-ϯ-ⲛⲟⲩϩⲉⲡ = 'who gives a judgment'. Same construction in line 30 (ⲉϩϯϩⲉⲡ).

Translated 'destroyed ones'. ⲧⲁⲭⲟ = causative of ⲧⲁⲕⲟ 'destroy'; qualitative ⲧⲁⲭⲁⲓⲧ 'destroyed'. Antithetical to ⲛⲉⲧⲇⲣⲁⲓⲧ 'victorious ones' — the standard pair-structure of cosmic judgment in this passage (winners ascend, destroyed are cast to the abyss, lines 17-18).

Tentatively rendered 'disturbance'. The form is unusual; possible relations: (a) ⲃⲱⲧⲥ̄ 'be removed/repelled'; (b) variant of ⲃⲱⲣⲇⲥ̄ 'tumult'; (c) ⲡⲱⲣϣ̄ 'spread out'. Context (multitude of archons of upper and lower) fits a noun of cosmic agitation/spreading. Flag for parallel research.

Wet/dry pair. ⲡⲉⲧϣⲟⲩⲱⲟⲩ clearly = 'the dry one' (ϣⲟⲟⲩⲉ 'be dry'). ⲡⲉⲧⲁⲇⲃⲉ accordingly = 'the moist/wet one' — possibly Lyc. variant of an unattested root for moisture, paired antithetically. The Virgin of Light's domain over moist and dry archons fits her standard Manichaean role with moon/water cycles.

Translated 'casting the righteous out from the sinners'. ⲛⲟⲩϩⲉ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲛ̄- = 'separate/cast forth from'. The directionality is the righteous being lifted out (saved) from the mass of sinners — fits the air-judge's discriminating function from line 31 (separating good from evil).
Lycopolitan feminine ordinal: ⲧ-ⲧ-ⲙⲁⲍ-ⲙⲛⲧⲥⲛⲁⲩⲥ = 'the twelfth.' Standard ordinal-prefix ⲙⲁⲍ- with cardinal ⲙⲛⲧⲥⲛⲁⲩⲥ '12.'

Identifies the twelfth judge (Counsel) AS the Call+Hearing pair, set within the elements. The twelfth judge = the cosmic Call/Answer dyad embedded in stoicheia. Direct correspondential identification per Manichaean exegesis.

Read as 'depicting himself by himself.' ⲍⲱⲣⲁⲫⲉ from ζωγραφέω 'paint, depict from life' (already in glossary). The ⲛ̄ϩ- prefix functions as circumstantial/participial. The cosmic Image self-depicting at the eschatological gathering.

ⲡⲁⲛⲁⲣⲉⲓⲁⲥ = ἀναίρεσις 'extraction, lifting-out, destruction' (per glossary). 'The destruction/lifting-out of the end' — the eschatological extraction of light at the cosmic terminus. Translated 'Pan-areias' to highlight the Greek loan; could equally be 'in the destruction.'
ⲛⲉⲉϩ = ⲛⲉⲉϥ 'bears up, sustains' (per glossary). The hidden Father bears up all twelve judges as Atlas-figure of the entire judicial structure.

Apophatic privative compound: ⲁⲧ- ('un-') + ⲧⲱⲙⲉ ('touch') + -ⲁⲣⲁϩ ('to him'). 'Untouchable to him' — characteristic Manichaean apophatic epithet of the hidden Father. ⲧⲱⲙⲉ already in vocabulary as 'touch/join.'
